question: Should `plugin.approval.cancel` plus nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` become the supported plugin approval cancellation contract, and must this PR apply it to every abort-aware waiter before merge?
rationale: The diff changes a public gateway/plugin SDK contract and leaves sibling abort-aware approval paths uncovered, so automation should not choose a narrower permanent API or partial scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Complete the cancellation contract before merge
options.body: Apply the new cancel RPC to the Codex app-server and native hook relay waiters too, and update contract docs/tests so `decision: null` is an intentional cleanup event.

options.title: Accept only the before_tool_call fix
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally land the narrower path, but the linked stale-approval issue should remain partially open for the other waiters.

options.title: Pause the public API change
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether cancellation should use nullable resolved events, a separate event, or another gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Complete the cancellation contract before merge
recommendation.body: Apply the new cancel RPC to the Codex app-server and native hook relay waiters too, and update contract docs/tests so `decision: null` is an intentional cleanup event.

likelyOwner.reason: The original plugin approval request/wait/resolve feature and UI integration history points to this owner as the best available contract-routing candidate.
